title: University of Minnesota Transplant Registry
summary: Under Transplant Information Services (TIS), the University of Minnesota Transplant Registry (UMTR) will serve as the repository for core research data.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Received a transplanted organ at the University of Minnesota
* Living donor who donates an organ at the University of Minnesota

Exclusion Criteria:

* Did not receive a transplant at the University of Minnesota
* Did not donate an organ at the University of Minnesota

sites.f: University of Minnesota Transplant Information Services
